q: A key weakness of notebooks for production is:
options: Hidden state and dependence on the order of cells
explain: Scripts run top to bottom in a known way.
They can then be changed and recorded without code edits.

q: Which is a suitable ML unit test?
options: The model file has a nice name
explain: It checks a guarantee that the service relies on.

q: Which should never go into logs?
explain: Logs spread widely and are hard to clean.

options: Stops a run when metrics are below a limit
explain: It keeps a bad model from being released.

options: Recorded seeds, pinned versions and versioned data
explain: Without these, nobody can recreate the result.

q: Which logging level suits a run that failed the quality gate?
explain: It reports a failure that needs attention.
It lets one run override settings.
